paragraphs.source_en: Thereafter, whenever military news arrived from Korea, Hideyoshi's views were unlike what they had once been. Perhaps Lady Yodo's pregnancy had overcome his wavering. He wanted to believe that the night was over and morning had come once more... Yet at times, this very thought became another cause for uncertainty.

units.source_en: Thereafter, whenever military news arrived from Korea, Hideyoshi's views were unlike what they had once been.
units.source_zh: 此后，每当由朝鲜送来军情，秀吉的意见都不同往常。

units.source_en: Perhaps Lady Yodo's pregnancy had overcome his wavering.
units.source_zh: 淀夫人的怀孕或许战胜了他的动摇。

units.source_en: He wanted to believe that the night was over and morning had come once more... Yet at times, this very thought became another cause for uncertainty.
units.source_zh: 他欲相信，夜晚已过，清晨再度来临……可是，有时这反而又成了动摇的原因。

paragraphs.source_zh: 此后，每当由朝鲜送来军情，秀吉的意见都不同往常。淀夫人的怀孕或许战胜了他的动摇。他欲相信，夜晚已过，清晨再度来临……可是，有时这反而又成了动摇的原因。

paragraphs.source_en: But from the first month of Bunroku's second year onward, events came thick and fast.

units.source_en: But from the first month of Bunroku's second year onward, events came thick and fast.
units.source_zh: 可是，文禄二年正月起，就诸事频频。

paragraphs.source_zh: 可是，文禄二年正月起，就诸事频频。

paragraphs.source_en: On the fifth day of the first month, Retired Emperor Ōgimachi passed away. That same day, the Ming commander Li Rusong, acting in concert with the Korean army, attacked Pyongyang... The two reports reached Nagoya almost simultaneously.

units.source_en: On the fifth day of the first month, Retired Emperor Ōgimachi passed away. That same day, the Ming commander Li Rusong, acting in concert with the Korean army, attacked Pyongyang... The two reports reached Nagoya almost simultaneously.
units.source_zh: 正月初五，正亲町太上皇驾崩，同一日，明将李如松和朝鲜军配合，一起进攻平壤……两个消息几乎同时抵达名护屋。

paragraphs.source_zh: 正月初五，正亲町太上皇驾崩，同一日，明将李如松和朝鲜军配合，一起进攻平壤……两个消息几乎同时抵达名护屋。

paragraphs.source_en: In Pyongyang, Konishi Yukinaga repeatedly sought ways to negotiate peace. Yukinaga believed that defeat by the Ming army would not only cost Hideyoshi face, but also plunge the commanders into an unforeseeably bitter struggle.

units.source_en: In Pyongyang, Konishi Yukinaga repeatedly sought ways to negotiate peace.
units.source_zh: 在平壤，有小西行长频频谋划议和之事。

units.source_en: Yukinaga believed that defeat by the Ming army would not only cost Hideyoshi face, but also plunge the commanders into an unforeseeably bitter struggle.
units.source_zh: 行长认为，如果败给明军，非但秀吉没有面子，诸将也会陷入难以预料的苦战之渊。

paragraphs.source_zh: 在平壤，有小西行长频频谋划议和之事。行长认为，如果败给明军，非但秀吉没有面子，诸将也会陷入难以预料的苦战之渊。

paragraphs.source_en: “In the end, I shall have to go myself. What use are those commissioners?” At times Hideyoshi made grand declarations, and at others he flaunted his power by holding tea gatherings; yet the hair at his temples was rapidly turning white, and his aging had become painfully apparent.

units.source_en: “In the end, I shall have to go myself. What use are those commissioners?”
units.source_zh: “毕竟我不去不行，奉行们顶什么用？”

units.source_en: At times Hideyoshi made grand declarations, and at others he flaunted his power by holding tea gatherings; yet the hair at his temples was rapidly turning white, and his aging had become painfully apparent.
units.source_zh: 秀吉有时放出大话，有时耀武扬威举行茶会，可是，他的鬓发迅速变白，衰老得甚是明显。

paragraphs.source_zh: “毕竟我不去不行，奉行们顶什么用？”秀吉有时放出大话，有时耀武扬威举行茶会，可是，他的鬓发迅速变白，衰老得甚是明显。

paragraphs.source_en: On the eighth day of the first month of Bunroku's second year, Konishi Yukinaga was surrounded in Pyongyang and suffered a crushing defeat at the hands of Li Rusong, who had set fire to Moranbong. At the same time, the Ming vanguard under Qian Shizhen and others crossed the Taedong River and advanced southward. Ishida Mitsunari, Mashita Nagamori, and the others stationed in the Korean capital also fell out openly with the Kuroda, Katō, and Kobayakawa commanders at this time; but in an effort to reverse their decline, they had no choice but to withdraw temporarily to the capital on the twenty-first day of the first month.

units.source_en: On the eighth day of the first month of Bunroku's second year, Konishi Yukinaga was surrounded in Pyongyang and suffered a crushing defeat at the hands of Li Rusong, who had set fire to Moranbong.
units.source_zh: 小西行长于文禄二年正月初八在平壤被围困，大败于烧了牡丹台的李如松。

units.source_en: At the same time, the Ming vanguard under Qian Shizhen and others crossed the Taedong River and advanced southward.
units.source_zh: 同时，明朝的先锋钱世桢等又渡过大同江南进。

units.source_en: Ishida Mitsunari, Mashita Nagamori, and the others stationed in the Korean capital also fell out openly with the Kuroda, Katō, and Kobayakawa commanders at this time; but in an effort to reverse their decline, they had no choice but to withdraw temporarily to the capital on the twenty-first day of the first month.
units.source_zh: 留守朝鲜京中的石田三成、增田长盛等，也在这个时候与黑田、加藤、小早川诸将撕破脸皮，但为了挽回颓势，不得不于正月二十一暂且退回京中。

paragraphs.source_zh: 小西行长于文禄二年正月初八在平壤被围困，大败于烧了牡丹台的李如松。同时，明朝的先锋钱世桢等又渡过大同江南进。留守朝鲜京中的石田三成、增田长盛等，也在这个时候与黑田、加藤、小早川诸将撕破脸皮，但为了挽回颓势，不得不于正月二十一暂且退回京中。

paragraphs.source_en: A council was held in the capital on the twenty-first day of the first month, and although many were reluctant, they had no choice but to acknowledge the truth of their situation.

units.source_en: A council was held in the capital on the twenty-first day of the first month, and although many were reluctant, they had no choice but to acknowledge the truth of their situation.
units.source_zh: 正月二十一在京城举行会议，虽然很多人不情愿，却不得不承认事实真相。

paragraphs.source_zh: 正月二十一在京城举行会议，虽然很多人不情愿，却不得不承认事实真相。

paragraphs.source_en: On the twenty-sixth day of the first month, Kobayakawa Takakage, Tachibana Muneshige, Kikkawa Hiroie, Ukita Hideie, Kuroda Nagamasa, and the others were struck by Li Rusong's counterattack at Byeokjegwan and, defeated, fled toward Pyongyang.

units.source_en: On the twenty-sixth day of the first month, Kobayakawa Takakage, Tachibana Muneshige, Kikkawa Hiroie, Ukita Hideie, Kuroda Nagamasa, and the others were struck by Li Rusong's counterattack at Byeokjegwan and, defeated, fled toward Pyongyang.
units.source_zh: 正月二十六，小早川隆景、立花宗茂、吉川广家、宇喜多秀家、黑田长政等，在碧蹄馆遭李如松的反攻而败走平壤。

paragraphs.source_zh: 正月二十六，小早川隆景、立花宗茂、吉川广家、宇喜多秀家、黑田长政等，在碧蹄馆遭李如松的反攻而败走平壤。

paragraphs.source_en: Katō Kiyomasa, who had reached the capital together with Nabeshima Naoshige on the twenty-ninth of that month, was defeated once again by Li Rusong on the sixteenth day of the second month. Konishi Yukinaga, Kuroda Nagamasa, Ishida Mitsunari, and the others re-formed their battle lines to attack the mountain fortress of Haengju...

units.source_en: Katō Kiyomasa, who had reached the capital together with Nabeshima Naoshige on the twenty-ninth of that month, was defeated once again by Li Rusong on the sixteenth day of the second month.
units.source_zh: 同月二十九，与锅岛直茂同抵京城的加藤清正，于二月十六再度为李如松所破。

units.source_en: Konishi Yukinaga, Kuroda Nagamasa, Ishida Mitsunari, and the others re-formed their battle lines to attack the mountain fortress of Haengju...
units.source_zh: 小西行长、黑田长政、石田三成等重建攻打幸州山城阵容……

paragraphs.source_zh: 同月二十九，与锅岛直茂同抵京城的加藤清正，于二月十六再度为李如松所破。小西行长、黑田长政、石田三成等重建攻打幸州山城阵容……

paragraphs.source_en: It took nearly a month for these battle reports to reach Hideyoshi. Thereafter, reports of defeat came one after another. It was probably around this time that Hideyoshi's regret began.

units.source_en: It took nearly a month for these battle reports to reach Hideyoshi.
units.source_zh: 花了将近一个月的时间，这些战报才送抵秀吉面前。

units.source_en: Thereafter, reports of defeat came one after another.
units.source_zh: 此后战败之报频传。

units.source_en: It was probably around this time that Hideyoshi's regret began.
units.source_zh: 秀吉的后悔，恐是从这个时候开始的。

paragraphs.source_zh: 花了将近一个月的时间，这些战报才送抵秀吉面前。此后战败之报频传。秀吉的后悔，恐是从这个时候开始的。

paragraphs.source_en: At times, foot soldiers and laborers who had fled the battlefield in defeat reached home before news of the defeat itself.

units.source_en: At times, foot soldiers and laborers who had fled the battlefield in defeat reached home before news of the defeat itself.
units.source_zh: 有时，由阵中败逃回来的步卒和民夫，要比失败的消息更先抵达国内。

paragraphs.source_zh: 有时，由阵中败逃回来的步卒和民夫，要比失败的消息更先抵达国内。

paragraphs.source_en: The shortage of provisions was dire, and the army's fate now depended on its capacity to transport supplies; this was no longer a problem that could be solved with bold words alone. Hideyoshi could not help growing deeply agitated.

units.source_en: The shortage of provisions was dire, and the army's fate now depended on its capacity to transport supplies; this was no longer a problem that could be solved with bold words alone.
units.source_zh: 缺粮甚是严重，粮秣运送能力决定了军队的命运，这已不是只靠豪言壮语能解决的了。

units.source_en: Hideyoshi could not help growing deeply agitated.

ja.t: らずにはいられなかった。

units.source_zh: 秀吉不免颇为焦躁。

paragraphs.source_zh: 缺粮甚是严重，粮秣运送能力决定了军队的命运，这已不是只靠豪言壮语能解决的了。秀吉不免颇为焦躁。

paragraphs.source_en: At the beginning of the third month, Hideyoshi ordered Mōri Terumoto to take delivery of provisions at Busan harbor and distribute them throughout the army. On the sixteenth day of the third month, the commanders in Korea submitted a letter stating that laborers were in short supply and asked Hideyoshi to postpone his crossing.

units.source_en: At the beginning of the third month, Hideyoshi ordered Mōri Terumoto to take delivery of provisions at Busan harbor and distribute them throughout the army.
units.source_zh: 秀吉于三月初命令毛利辉元在釜山浦领取兵粮，向全军配发。

units.source_en: On the sixteenth day of the third month, the commanders in Korea submitted a letter stating that laborers were in short supply and asked Hideyoshi to postpone his crossing.
units.source_zh: 在朝诸将于三月十六上书说人夫短缺，请求秀吉延期渡海。

paragraphs.source_zh: 秀吉于三月初命令毛利辉元在釜山浦领取兵粮，向全军配发。在朝诸将于三月十六上书说人夫短缺，请求秀吉延期渡海。

paragraphs.source_en: On the third day of the fourth month, Hideyoshi rescinded the order to punish deserters; on the twelfth, he ordered the vessels originally intended to carry troops across the sea to be converted into supply ships for transporting provisions to the army in Korea, and announced that his crossing would be suspended; thereafter, he ordered the main army to withdraw from the Korean capital and sternly commanded Asano Nagamasa at Busan harbor to escort the provisions and send them onward without delay.

units.source_en: On the third day of the fourth month, Hideyoshi rescinded the order to punish deserters;
units.source_zh: 秀吉于四月初三取缔了惩罚逃兵的命令；

units.source_en: on the twelfth, he ordered the vessels originally intended to carry troops across the sea to be converted into supply ships for transporting provisions to the army in Korea, and announced that his crossing would be suspended;
units.source_zh: 四月十二，下令原渡海所用兵船改为运粮船，向在朝军队输送粮草，宣布暂停渡海；

units.source_en: thereafter, he ordered the main army to withdraw from the Korean capital and sternly commanded Asano Nagamasa at Busan harbor to escort the provisions and send them onward without delay.
units.source_zh: 此后，命令大军从朝鲜京城撤退，严令在釜山浦的浅野长政护送军粮，迅速遣返。

paragraphs.source_zh: 秀吉于四月初三取缔了惩罚逃兵的命令；四月十二，下令原渡海所用兵船改为运粮船，向在朝军队输送粮草，宣布暂停渡海；此后，命令大军从朝鲜京城撤退，严令在釜山浦的浅野长政护送军粮，迅速遣返。

paragraphs.source_en: Even the capital, which they had swept into their hands immediately after landing, now had to be abandoned. While withdrawing, they also had to devise terms for peace.

units.source_en: Even the capital, which they had swept into their hands immediately after landing, now had to be abandoned.

ja.t: しなければならなかった。

units.source_zh: 连登陆时一气攻下来的京城，也必须放弃。

units.source_en: While withdrawing, they also had to devise terms for peace.

ja.t: さなければならなかった。

units.source_zh: 撤退期间，还须想出议和的条件。

paragraphs.source_zh: 连登陆时一气攻下来的京城，也必须放弃。撤退期间，还须想出议和的条件。

paragraphs.source_en: The Ming envoy Shen Weijing, who had met Konishi Yukinaga before, met him again at Yongsan on the twelfth day of the fourth month to discuss peace negotiations. By then Hideyoshi was fully aware of how unfavorable the war had become, but he was unwilling to admit it. The brilliance of the first half of his life was undergoing a swift and uncanny transformation.

units.source_en: The Ming envoy Shen Weijing, who had met Konishi Yukinaga before, met him again at Yongsan on the twelfth day of the fourth month to discuss peace negotiations.
units.source_zh: 以前和小西行长见过面的明使沈惟敬，和行长于四月十二再度相会于龙山，讨论议和事宜。

units.source_en: By then Hideyoshi was fully aware of how unfavorable the war had become, but he was unwilling to admit it.

ja.t: めようとはしなかった。

units.source_zh: 此时秀吉已充分意识到战局的不利，却不愿承认。

units.source_en: The brilliance of the first half of his life was undergoing a swift and uncanny transformation.
units.source_zh: 他前半生的辉煌，正在发生急速而奇异的变化。

paragraphs.source_zh: 以前和小西行长见过面的明使沈惟敬，和行长于四月十二再度相会于龙山，讨论议和事宜。此时秀吉已充分意识到战局的不利，却不愿承认。他前半生的辉煌，正在发生急速而奇异的变化。

paragraphs.source_en: On the eighth day of the fifth month, Ishida Mitsunari, Mashita Nagamori, Ōtani Yoshitsugu, Konishi Yukinaga, and the others, wishing to discuss the terms of peace, left representatives in Busan to negotiate with the Ming envoy Shen Weijing, while they themselves returned to Nagoya.

units.source_en: On the eighth day of the fifth month, Ishida Mitsunari, Mashita Nagamori, Ōtani Yoshitsugu, Konishi Yukinaga, and the others, wishing to discuss the terms of peace, left representatives in Busan to negotiate with the Ming envoy Shen Weijing, while they themselves returned to Nagoya.
units.source_zh: 五月初八，石田三成、增田长盛、大谷吉继、小西行长等，为了商量议和的条件，留人与明使沈惟敬在釜山周旋，自身则回到了名护屋。

paragraphs.source_zh: 五月初八，石田三成、增田长盛、大谷吉继、小西行长等，为了商量议和的条件，留人与明使沈惟敬在釜山周旋，自身则回到了名护屋。
